data.title: Donald Trump says US will win Iran war 'very soon,' in talks with mediators | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "We're going to win; as far as I'm concerned, it's going to be one way or the other," Trump said in the Oval Office. "It's going to go pretty quickly."
